class pystxmcontrol.controller.controller.controller(simulation=False, logger=None)

Bases: object

__init__(simulation=False, logger=None)

simulation (boolean) – simulation mode

Reads required configuration files, initializes motors, controllers and daqs and manages all hardware communication. Also manages the calibration of the zone plate position for a given photon energy.

Parameters:

config (dict) – motor configuration dictionary

None

Adds to an existing dictionary with a newly defined controller. For | controller = config[“controller”] | address = config[‘controllerID’] | port = config[‘port’] | This executes: controllerType(address = address, port = port) which initializes the controller class and communication with the device.

class pystxmcontrol.controller.dataHandler.dataHandler(controller, lock=None, logger=None)

Bases: object

__init__(controller, lock=None, logger=None)
addDataToStack(scanInfo, daq)

This function puts the raw data into the data structure and returns the data that will be the “image” which the user analyzes. This is also what is displayed in the GUI. The philosophy here is that the scan driver decides what the correct indices are and this function just puts the data there. So no need to calculate what “i” is here, for example. scanInfo[“rawData”] is the uninterpolated data where as scanInfo[“data”] is interpolated. Not all scans need do the interpolation, like ptychography and single/double motor scans.

pystxmcontrol.controller.scans.base_scan module

Abstract base class for STXM scan routines.

This module provides a base class that encapsulates common functionality shared across different scan types (line scans, focus scans, point scans, etc.).

class pystxmcontrol.controller.scans.base_scan.BaseScan(scan: Dict, dataHandler, controller, queue)

Bases: ABC

Abstract base class for STXM scan implementations.

This class provides common functionality for: - DAQ configuration and metadata management - Motor positioning and trajectory setup - Energy handling and focus control - Coarse/fine motor coordination - Scan region management

Subclasses must implement: - execute_scan(): Main scan execution logic - setup_scan_geometry(): Scan-specific geometric setup

This is a particle finding routine. It takes as input a large overview scan and then attempts to locate the particles. It also defines a bounding box around each particle which can be used as a STXM scan region. The list of scan regions is the output.

pystxmcontrol.controller.operation_logger module

Operation Logger for pystxmcontrol

Logs motor moves and scan operations to SQLite database with minimal overhead. Uses async queue pattern to avoid blocking motor operations.

pystxmcontrol.controller.zmq_publisher module

ZMQ Publisher for pystxmcontrol

Handles all ZeroMQ socket management and publishing for: - CCD frame data - STXM scan data - Scan start/stop events

Separated from dataHandler for clarity and testability.
